summary: Cronmaster is a self-hosted user interface designed for managing cron jobs. It allows you to define schedules using human-readable syntax while providing live output logging and historical run data.
goodFor: It is a suitable tool for developers or system administrators who want a centralised web interface to monitor and manage scheduled tasks across their infrastructure.
watchOut: The project has a modest community footprint and an AGPL-3.0 licence, which may introduce compliance considerations if you modify and distribute the source code within a commercial network.
deployNotes: Because it is distributed as a Docker container, you will typically need to configure persistent storage volumes to preserve your job history and ensure a reverse proxy is set up in front of it for TLS termination.
